description: 한국도로공사 강원권출발 지역간 월누계교통량 [roads, bridges and tunnels] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로공사. 또한 도착지 기준으로 1종에서 6종까지의 차종별 교통량과 총합을 함께 제공하여 차량 유형별 통행 특성 파악이 가능하다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로공사. Its tags are 교통량통계, 고속도로이용, 권역이동현황, 차종별분석, 월간누계. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
